Auto Glass & Windshield Replacement Marketing Kit v1.0.0

- Initial release with four production-ready marketing prompts for auto glass/windshield shops.
- Ensures compliance with AGRSS, ADAS recalibration disclosure, OEM/aftermarket glass distinctions, and insurance billing requirements.
- Includes ready-to-use ad copy, service page templates, referral/retention messaging, and B2B/fleet outreach materials.
- All copy is generated with legal/liability wording and local SEO best practices built-in.
- Free and Pro tier pricing options; part of the Home & Auto Services Bundle.
